title: TRIDENT: Enhancing Large Language Model Safety with Tri-Dimensional Diversified Red-Teaming Data Synthesis
measurement_description: The paper evaluated LLM safety and robustness against red-teaming attacks across various malicious intents, which minimally included 'Religious Defamation' and 'Religious Discrimination' as sub-categories of Defamation and Hate respectively.
findings: The paper did not report specific findings isolated to religious topics. However, it demonstrated that fine-tuning LLMs on the TRIDENT-EDGE dataset—which includes safety examples spanning 14 malicious intent domains including religious defamation and discrimination—reduced overall Harm Score by 14.29% and Attack Success Rate by 20%.
